# Built with Claude in 28 Days

> A non-fiction book and living portfolio documenting what one non-technical founder built using Claude as a development partner. Five products shipped in 28 days, $70/month to run. The projects kept growing after publication.

## Author
- [Rodrigo Madriz](https://builtwithclaudebook.com/) — Toronto-based technology entrepreneur, mechanical engineer, former adjunct faculty at Toronto Metropolitan University

## The Book
- [English Edition on Amazon](https://www.amazon.ca/dp/B0GVPXGS5Q) — Built with Claude in 28 Days
- [Spanish Edition on Amazon](https://www.amazon.ca/dp/B0GX2WTWVD) — 28 Días con Claude
- [Companion Site (English)](https://builtwithclaudebook.com/)
- [Companion Site (Spanish)](https://builtwithclaudebook.com/es/)

## Projects from the Book — Current Status (August 2026)
- [Project Updates](https://builtwithclaudebook.com/updates.html) — Where all five projects are now
- [HomeGadgets.ca](https://homegadgets.ca) — Canadian price comparison, 20K+ SKUs, 125+ retailers, 20 categories, MCP server, AI search, enterprise API
- [ShopButler.ai](https://shopbutler.ai) — Agentic shopping framework for consumer-driven AI commerce
- [Credentia.one](https://credentia.one) — Open document standard for job applications (.credentia.json)
- [ContextQuant.com](https://contextquant.com) — Quantitative NLP research platform, SEC document analysis
- [BasketBrain.ca](https://basketbrain.ca) — Canadian grocery price comparison (parked)

## Free Resources
